description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Font, which validates and processes the CSS shorthand property 'font' within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for constructing the validator with configuration data and for validating font property strings.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Font
classes.description: A class that validates the CSS 'font' shorthand property, parsing components like font-style, font-variant, font-weight, font-size, line-height, and font-family.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the font validator with CSS definitions from the configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a font property string, parsing and verifying font components, and handling keywords and shorthand notation.
